Series.to_parquet() deployment requires PyArrow ≥10.0.0 as hard dependency with temp directory configuration for cloud environments. Security mandates include path validation and Series.name sanitization. Scalability targets: 2x memory overhead, compression within 5s/GB (gzip) or 2s/GB (snappy), file size ≤1.1x uncompressed. Operational procedures: retry logic with exponential backoff, INFO/WARNING logging, automatic cleanup of partial writes. Cost optimization via streaming writes and memory-efficient serialization.
